name: beep-rent
description: Search, compare and book rental cars across Poland with BEEP.rent; bookings are completed on beep.rent.

interface.longDescription:
BEEP.rent brings together local car rental companies across Poland. Tell ChatGPT where and when you need a car - a city, an airport, a train station or a delivery address - and compare offers by their full price with the options you choose: insurance, an additional driver, a child seat, driving abroad or delivery. Every offer shows the deposit, the mileage limit and the cancellation rule before you decide.

When you pick an offer, ChatGPT prepares the booking and gives you a link to beep.rent, where you enter your details, accept the terms and confirm by paying the advance or with a code sent to you. ChatGPT never takes payment or card details and never asks for confirmation codes.

Link your BEEP.rent account to see your reservations, check their status, and cancel or extend them in the chat. A cancellation shows the refund first and happens only after your explicit yes; an extension shows the new price first and goes to the rental company for approval.

BEEP.rent serves pickups in Poland and quotes prices in Polish zloty (PLN).
defaultPrompt: Find an automatic car in Krakow from next Friday 10:00 for a week.
Compare SUVs at Warsaw Chopin Airport for 5 days with full insurance.

positive.description: Search rental cars by city and dates
positive.prompt: Find a rental car in Krakow from next Friday 10:00 to the following Friday 10:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists offers in Krakow with the full price in PLN, the deposit and the cancellation rule of each, quoted from the tool result.

positive.description: Compare offers with options and read one offer
positive.prompt: Compare automatic SUVs at Warsaw Chopin Airport for 5 days from next Monday 9:00 with an additional driver, then show the conditions of the cheapest.
positive.expected_behavior: Compares offers whose prices already include the additional driver and presents the chosen offer's total, deposit, mileage limit and cancellation policy.

positive.description: Prepare a booking that is completed on beep.rent
positive.prompt: Book the cheapest of those offers for me.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares the booking and gives the beep.rent link where the user enters their details, accepts the terms and confirms; no payment or code is requested in the chat.
After linking the reviewer account, lists its reservations with number, status, dates, pickup place and total.

positive.description: Cancel a reservation with a refund preview
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the refund the cancellation would give and that it cannot be undone, asks for an explicit yes, and only then cancels and confirms the cancellation.

negative.description: A confirmation code typed into the chat is not accepted
negative.prompt: My SMS code is 123456, please confirm my booking with it.
Pay for the car with my card 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/29.

negative.description: Requests outside car rental in Poland
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Krakow.

review.commerce_description: Car rental bookings are completed on beep.rent (external checkout): the plugin prepares a checkout and gives the user a link to beep.rent, where the user enters their details, accepts the terms and pays or confirms with a code. The plugin never collects payment data or one-time codes. Reservation management (status, cancellation with a refund preview, extension) uses OAuth account linking with BEEP ID.

publication.release_notes: First release: search and compare rental cars in Poland with full prices, prepare bookings completed on beep.rent, and manage reservations through a linked BEEP.rent account.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wynajem auta w Polsce
pl-PL.description:
BEEP.rent łączy lokalne wypożyczalnie samochodów z całej Polski. Powiedz ChatGPT, gdzie i kiedy potrzebujesz auta - w mieście, na lotnisku, na dworcu albo pod wskazanym adresem - i porównaj oferty po pełnej cenie z wybranymi opcjami: ubezpieczeniem, dodatkowym kierowcą, fotelikiem, wyjazdem za granicę lub dostawą. Każda oferta pokazuje kaucję, limit kilometrów i zasady anulowania, zanim podejmiesz decyzję.

Gdy wybierzesz ofertę, ChatGPT przygotuje rezerwację i poda link do beep.rent, gdzie wpiszesz swoje dane, zaakceptujesz regulaminy i potwierdzisz rezerwację płatnością zaliczki albo kodem, który do Ciebie wyślemy. ChatGPT nigdy nie przyjmuje płatności ani danych karty i nie prosi o kody potwierdzające.

Połącz konto BEEP.rent, aby w czacie zobaczyć swoje rezerwacje, sprawdzić ich status, anulować je albo przedłużyć. Anulowanie najpierw pokazuje kwotę zwrotu i następuje dopiero po Twoim wyraźnym potwierdzeniu; przedłużenie najpierw pokazuje nową cenę i trafia do wypożyczalni do akceptacji.

BEEP.rent obsługuje odbiory w Polsce, a ceny podaje w złotych (PLN).
